purpose: pre-execution analysis design, not an executable harness configuration
repeat_count_rationale: initial descriptive replication; no power claim

inferential_policy.multiplicity: Holm if confirmatory p-values are reported
inferential_policy.audit_p_values: unadjusted, conditional on one saved run
inferential_policy.repeat_aggregation: report each replicate and within-read accuracy delta; do not pool rows as independent observations
inferential_policy.stopping: fixed repeat count; changes require a new contract before execution

execution_gates: complete matched question IDs and metadata
all cost components known and reservation accounting connected to callers
runtime query path matches declared query strategy
provider/model revisions and runtime settings recorded to available precision
reader-only replay must not call retrieval
